name: Magical Armillary Sphere
description: An enchanted armillary sphere that continually tracks astrological time and planetary influences, halving the Ease Factor of Astrological Duration calculations.

name: Craft the Mechanism
description: Cr(In)Te 35 Ritual used to magically craft the mechanism of an armillary sphere, requiring design and Finesse rolls.

name: Know the Heavens
description: InVi 29 constant enchantment in the magical armillary sphere that senses astrological time and the influence of the planets around it.

name: Track the Heavens
description: ReTe 28 enchantment linked to Know the Heavens that keeps the armillary sphere adjusted to current local astrological time.

name: Astrological Duration
description: A spell duration tied to astrological conditions whose calculations can be eased by consulting a magical armillary sphere.

name: Divine Heaven's Aspect
description: Spell used to learn astrological conditions at a distant location so the armillary sphere can be adjusted.

name: Magoi of the Star
description: Mystery cult of Christian astrologers, the Order of Hermes' greatest astrologers, who use astrology to overcome planetary influence and exercise free will; organized into seven degrees.

name: Origen
description: Early Church theologian and biblical scholar whose ideas on free will and the stars heavily influence the Magoi of the Star; his tomb is at Tyre.

name: Trajan Decius
description: Roman emperor under whose persecution (250 AD) Origen was imprisoned and tortured.

name: Tyre
description: City where Origen's tomb is honored, a site of importance to the Magoi of the Star.

name: Three Wise Men
description: The biblical magi Caspar, Melchior and Balthasar, revered by the Magoi of the Star, whose relics lie in the Shrine of Kings at Cologne.

name: Caspar
description: One of the Three Wise Men whose body lies in the Shrine of Kings at Cologne Cathedral.

name: Melchior
description: One of the Three Wise Men whose body lies in the Shrine of Kings at Cologne Cathedral.

name: Balthasar
description: One of the Three Wise Men whose body lies in the Shrine of Kings at Cologne Cathedral.

name: Shrine of Kings
description: Shrine in Cologne Cathedral holding the bodies of the Three Wise Men, brought from Milan in 1164.

name: Cologne Cathedral
description: Cathedral holding the relics of the Three Wise Men; every Magoi of the Star must make pilgrimage there for Christmas Day.

name: Cologne
description: City holding the relics of the three magi and a rumored headquarters of the Magoi of the Star.

name: Milan
description: City from which the relics of the Three Wise Men were brought to Cologne in 1164.

name: Frederick I
description: Emperor who brought the relics of the Three Wise Men from Milan to Cologne in 1164.

name: Empress Helena
description: Empress who originally discovered the bodies of the Three Wise Men on her pilgrimage to the Holy Land.

name: Holy Land
description: Region where Empress Helena discovered the relics of the Three Wise Men.

name: Bethlehem
description: Pilgrimage destination and rumored cult headquarters of the Magoi of the Star.

name: Babylon
description: Rumored headquarters of the Magoi of the Star visited by Initiates of the Degree of Mercury.

name: Augustine
description: Great Church father whose wisdom orthodox churchmen hold; in The City of God he distinguishes dulia from latria.

name: Antichrist
description: Prophesied figure whose portents the Magoi of the Star are currently fervently investigating.

name: Nativity Horoscope
description: Horoscope cast from a person's time and place of birth, taking a day's work; its bonus can aid astrological divination.

name: Daily Horoscope
description: Horoscope calculated for a person's current location in an hour with Intelligence + Artes Liberales (Astronomy).

name: Limit of Time
description: Hermetic limit preventing true knowledge of the future; considered Divine by the Magoi and constraining Hermetic Divination.

name: Degree of Saturn
description: First degree of the Magoi of the Star, requiring Artes Liberales 4+ and initiating Planetary Magic; members wear black gowns.

name: Degree of Jupiter
description: Second degree of the Magoi of the Star, granting Potent Magic in the Initiate's birth house; robes deep blue.

name: Degree of Mars
description: Third degree of the Magoi of the Star, in red robes, opposing infernalists and initiating Periapts.

name: Degree of Venus
description: Fourth degree of the Magoi of the Star, in emerald robe, teaching the Major Virtue Celestial Magic.

name: Degree of Mercury
description: Degree of the Magoi of the Star requiring teaching and travel, granting a Major Magical Focus relating to the Potent house.

name: Wise One
description: Degree of the Magoi of the Star wearing silver robes with the New Moon, taught Divination and Augury: Astrology.

name: Hierophants
description: The three mysterious leaders of the Magoi of the Star, greatest astrologers able to Initiate many astrological Virtues.

name: Planetary Magic
description: Virtue initiated at the Degree of Saturn; allows selecting a governing planet for enchantments and is prerequisite for astrological divination.

name: Potent Magic
description: Minor Virtue granted at the Degree of Jupiter, tied to the Initiate's birth house or planet.

name: Astrological Magical Foci
description: Modified Hermetic Virtue referenced alongside Potent Magic in astrological Mysteries.

name: Periapts
description: Virtue learned at the Degree of Mars of the Magoi of the Star.

name: Celestial Magic
description: Major Virtue teaching the secrets of astrology, initiated at the Degree of Venus.

name: Major Magical Focus
description: Virtue taught at the Degree of Mercury relating to the Potent house; Graculus has one in Necromancy.

name: Divination and Augury
description: Major Supernatural Virtue allowing Hermetic magi to interpret signs to answer questions like momentary Intellego spells.

name: Divination
description: Supernatural Ability learned at level 1 upon Initiation into a first method of divination, used in divination rolls.

name: Artes Liberales
description: Ability required at 4+ for the Degree of Saturn; used with Astronomy for horoscopes.

name: Astronomy
description: Knowledge (specialty of Artes Liberales) used to design armillary spheres and cast horoscopes.

name: Craft
description: Craft Ability (Mechanisms or Clocks) usable to design an armillary sphere.

name: Finesse
description: Ability used to guide magic into the correct crafted form of the armillary mechanism.

name: Medicine
description: Ability often taught to Initiates of the Degree of Mars as they learn about the four humors.

name: Magic Theory
description: Ability limiting Name of Power bonuses and used in spirit familiar bonding lab totals.

name: Doctrine of Origen
description: Origen's heretical teachings including the Perfectibility of Man and that stars are living beings and signs rather than causes.

name: Perfectibility of Man
description: Origen's heretical doctrine that there is no damnation and all things will eventually be saved.

name: Zodiac
description: The 12 great constellations whose signs, decans and houses form the basis of astrological correspondences.

name: Aries
description: Sign of the Zodiac with its own element, temperament and decans in astrological correspondences.

name: Taurus
description: Sign of the Zodiac with its own element, temperament and decans in astrological correspondences.

name: Gemini
description: Sign of the Zodiac with its own element, temperament and decans in astrological correspondences.

name: Cancer
description: Sign of the Zodiac with its own element, temperament and decans in astrological correspondences.

name: Leo
description: Sign of the Zodiac with its own element, temperament and decans in astrological correspondences.

name: Virgo
description: Sign of the Zodiac with its own element, temperament and decans in astrological correspondences.

name: Libra
description: Sign of the Zodiac with its own element, temperament and decans in astrological correspondences.

name: Scorpio
description: Sign of the Zodiac with its own element, temperament and decans in astrological correspondences.

name: Sagittarius
description: Sign of the Zodiac with its own element, temperament and decans in astrological correspondences.

name: Capricorn
description: Sign of the Zodiac with its own element, temperament and decans in astrological correspondences.

name: Aquarius
description: Sign of the Zodiac with its own element, temperament and decans in astrological correspondences.

name: Pisces
description: Sign of the Zodiac with its own element, temperament and decans in astrological correspondences.

name: Decans
description: Three sub-periods into which each sign of the Zodiac is divided, revealing different aspects of the sign's influence.

name: Astrological Houses
description: The 12 divisions of a horoscope chart (Vita, Lucrum, Frates, Genitor, Nati, Valetudo, Uxor, Mors, Pietas, Regnum, Benefacta, Carcer), each with its own province.

name: Ascendant
description: The sign rising over the eastern horizon at a given time and place, the starting point of a horoscope.

name: Four Humors
description: Choleric, phlegmatic, sanguine and melancholic humors corresponding to the four elements and the signs.

name: The Sun
description: Planet influencing rulership, kings, health; governs Presence and Stamina.

name: The Moon
description: Planet influencing emotions, tides, cyclic magic, fertility; governs Dexterity.

name: Mercury
description: Planet influencing journeys, writing, books and messengers; governs Quickness.

name: Venus
description: Planet influencing beauty, romance, marriage and performing arts; governs Communication.

name: Mars
description: Planet influencing war, violence, ambition and sex; governs Strength.

name: Jupiter
description: Planet influencing merriment, reason, prosperity and luck; governs Intelligence.

name: Saturn
description: Planet influencing age, time, wisdom and resisting distraction; governs Perception.

name: John of Salisbury
description: Twelfth-century writer (1115-1180) whose Policraticus complains of diviners at court; he crystal-gazed as a pupil.

name: Policraticus
description: Work by John of Salisbury complaining about diviners common at court.

name: Leiden papyri
description: Ancient papyri containing a list of 37 substances and plants with their mystical names.

name: John of Mirfeld
description: English writer giving techniques for prognosis by magical means, including onomancy.

name: Carneades
description: Early critic of astrology and divination (219-126 BC).

name: Cicero
description: Roman critic (106-43 BC) whose treatise On Divination ridiculed divine messages in dreams.

name: On Divination
description: Cicero's treatise ridiculing the notion that the gods communicate through dreams.

name: Synod of Ancyra
description: Church synod whose material fed a penitential punishing those who practice auguries and pagan divination.

name: Remus
description: Example Quaesitor whose intentions to visit a covenant are the subject of a divination example.

name: Quaesitor
description: Hermetic investigator, exemplified by Remus in the divination example.

name: Code of Hermes
description: Law of the Order forbidding magi from court divination, scrying on sodales, and dealing with demons.

name: Order of Hermes
description: Order of Hermetic magi whose greatest astrologers are the Magoi of the Star.

name: Casual Divination
description: One-round divination observing signs in the immediate environment, rolled with Perception + Divination.

name: Ceremonial Divination
description: Divination taking 15 minutes per 5 Ease Factor, using sympathetic magic and devices, rolled with Intelligence + Divination.

name: Ceremonial Augury Phenomena
description: Table of divinatory techniques (aeromancy through scrying) with bonuses for types of questions.

name: Aeromancy
description: Divinatory method using patterns in the air, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Alectryomancy
description: Divinatory method using eating behavior of chickens, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Aleuromancy
description: Divinatory method using burning or cooking flour, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Alomancy
description: Divinatory method using patterns in thrown salt, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Alphitomancy
description: Divinatory method using eating barley bread, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Apantomancy
description: Divinatory method using chance meetings with animals, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Ashagalomancy
description: Divinatory method using casting bones, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Axinomancy
description: Divinatory method using balancing a hatchet, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Belomancy
description: Divinatory method using shooting arrows in the air, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Botanomancy
description: Divinatory method using burning sticks carved with questions, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Capnomancy
description: Divinatory method using fumes from burning poppies, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Causimomancy
description: Divinatory method using behavior of objects placed in a fire, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Cephalomancy
description: Divinatory method using severing the head of a goat or donkey, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Ceroscopy
description: Divinatory method using patterns of wax dripped in water, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Cleidomancy
description: Divinatory method using dangling a key from the Bible, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Cleromancy
description: Divinatory method using casting dice or lots, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Crystalomancy
description: Divinatory method using crystal-gazing, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Geomancy
description: Divinatory method using patterns in earth, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Haruspicy
description: Divinatory method using entrails of sacrificed animals, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Hippomancy
description: Divinatory method using behavior of horses, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Hydromancy
description: Divinatory method using observing water, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Lecanomancy
description: Divinatory method using bowls of fluid, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Myomancy
description: Divinatory method using behavior of mice and rats, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Onomancy
description: Divinatory method using comparing names, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Ooscopy
description: Divinatory method using burning or cooking eggs, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Ophiomancy
description: Divinatory method using behavior of serpents, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Phyllorhodomancy
description: Divinatory method using rose bush leaves, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Pyromancy
description: Divinatory method using observing flames, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Rhabdomancy
description: Divinatory method using divining rods, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Scapulomancy
description: Divinatory method using roasting shoulder blades, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Scrying
description: Divinatory method using gazing into reflective surfaces, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

name: Astrology
description: The most prestigious divinatory art of the 13th century; as a method of Hermetic Divination it requires Planetary Magic.

name: Dream Interpretation
description: Method of divination by interpreting dreams, popular but of mixed repute; basis of Hermetic Dream Interpreter.

name: Numerology
description: Divination method requiring Hermetic Numerology, drawing bonuses from a numerologist's book.

name: Hermetic Numerology
description: Virtue prerequisite for numerological divination that adds bonuses from a numerologist's book.

name: Hermetic Astrology
description: Mystery school working astrological influences into general Hermetic magic.

name: Hermetic Mathematics
description: Mystery working numerical influences into general Hermetic magic (Arithmetic Magic).

name: Dream Interpreter
description: Divine Virtue, variant of Divination and Augury, prerequisite for Hermetic Divination (Dream Interpretation).

name: Hermetic Dream Interpreter
description: Major Supernatural Mystery Virtue: a specialized method of Hermetic Divination through interpreting dreams, with Dream Calling and symbolic interpretation.

name: Dream Calling
description: Dream interpreter ability to make a touched sleeper dream about a chosen subject (Ease Factor 6).

name: Symbolic Interpretation
description: Non-magical interpretation of dreams' symbolic meaning rolled with Intelligence + Divination (Dream Interpretation).

name: Enchantment of the Scrying Device
description: In(Forms) general Mystery effect enchanted into a divinatory device, giving a magical bonus of effect level/10 to divination.

name: Sailor's Foretaste of the Morrow
description: Intellego Auram 20 spell predicting weather, used as equivalent for a divination about rain.

name: Frosty Breath of the Spoken Lie
description: Common spell detecting lies, compared with a divination about whether someone is lying.

name: Thurydices
description: Example Redcap whose fate is the subject of a divination example.

name: Redcap
description: Messenger of the Order, e.g. Thurydices.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Sympathetic link to a target; in divination one held in hand counts as touching the target.

name: Regio
description: Hidden magical area that can be detected by divination.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: The covenant's protective Aegis ritual; spirits need an Aegis Token to enter.

name: Aegis Token
description: Token allowing a spirit familiar to enter within an Aegis.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power used in enchantment and rituals; ghosts may leave ghostly vis behind.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance that divinations and spells must penetrate; shared between magus and spirit familiar.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic magic resistance that does not stack with a familiar's resistance and leaves with the spirit.

name: Aura
description: Supernatural aura modifier added to divination rolls and familiar bonding.

name: Tribunal
description: Hermetic assembly that might convict a magus; the Living Ghost legal issue has never been tested there.

name: Determinata
description: Example maga seeking her missing shield grog via sympathetic divination.

name: Numera
description: Example Hermetic Numerologist using a copy of De Theoria Magica as her numerologist's book.

name: De Theoria Magica
description: Bonisagus' work, a copy of which Numera uses as her numerologist's book.

name: Bonisagus
description: Author of De Theoria Magica.

name: Numerologist's Book
description: A book opened with vis for numerology, giving Ceremonial Bonuses to divination.

name: Notarius
description: Example magus who enchants an astrolabe for Ceremonial Astrology.

name: Astrolabe
description: Instrument that may be enchanted as a divinatory device, as Notarius does.

name: Talisman
description: A magus's attuned personal enchanted item; spirits bound in it are released if broken, and may be one's own spirit via Inscription on the Soul.

name: Spirit Magic
description: Hermetic school of summoning and binding minor spirits into magical workings; preferred term over necromancy.

name: Necromancy
description: Originally conversing with the dead; by the 13th century covering evocation of spirits and demons.

name: William of Auvergne
description: Claims to have seen manuals of necromancy as a student at Paris.

name: Paris
description: City where William of Auvergne studied and whose archbishop condemned necromantic books.

name: Reims
description: City whence comes a 12th-century manuscript with a spell for causing spirits to torment someone.

name: Michael Scot
description: Scholar asserting astrological images conjure astral powers and damned souls in the wind.

name: Arnold of Villanova
description: Stated that spirits could not be coerced and came voluntarily.

name: John of Frankfurt
description: Stated with Arnold of Villanova that spirits come voluntarily.

name: Alexander III
description: Pope (1159-81) during whose pontificate a priest was suspended for calling up a demon.

name: Aquileia
description: Diocese where a priest was suspended for two years for summoning a demon.

name: Egyptian days
description: Inauspicious days whose observation was a forbidden practice for inquisitors.

name: Hermetic Theurgy
description: Name magic school/Virtue dealing with names of spirits and bargains with powerful Daimons via Invoke spells.

name: Daimon
description: Ancient, named individual spirits such as heroes, pagan deities or grove spirits, which manifest through Aspects.

name: Aspect
description: A projection of a Daimon that can manifest in several places; summoned instead of the Daimon itself.

name: Hermetic Empowerment
description: Minor Mystery Virtue allowing a device to power Ritual/vis-requiring effects by draining a bound spirit's Might.

name: Spell Binding
description: Virtue prerequisite for Hermetic Empowerment, allowing spirits to be bound into magical workings.

name: The Bountiful Feast
description: Ritual requiring marching the bounds, which cannot be empowered in a device.

name: Ritual Magic
description: Magic requiring vis and extended casting; Hermetic Divination cannot simulate it, Empowerment can power it in devices.

name: Ignavus
description: Example magus who plans a wand with a Disenchant Ritual to destroy a rival cult's shield.

name: Disenchant
description: Ritual that destroys enchantments; Ignavus plans to invest it in a wand.

name: Might
description: Supernatural power score of spirits, drained permanently by Empowering Prisons and used by Living Ghosts.

name: Medica
description: Example maga with a Staff of Healing powered by a bound spirit.

name: Staff of Healing
description: Medica's staff with healing Rituals powered by a bound Might 27 spirit.

name: Heal a Medium Wound
description: CrCo 25 healing Ritual invested in Medica's Staff of Healing.

name: Heal an Incapacitating Wound
description: CrCo 35 healing Ritual invested in Medica's Staff of Healing.

name: Empowering Prison of the Declining Spirit
description: Re(Mu)Vi(Forms) general Mystery enchantment that traps a spirit in a device and drains its Might to power Ritual effects.

name: Faerie Magic
description: Virtue allowing magi to link to Faerie spirits for empowerment, familiars or invocation.

name: Magic Realm
description: Realm of spirits most magi work with; some theurgists believe Initiate souls travel there after death.

name: Faerie Realm
description: Realm of faerie spirits accessible to those with Faerie Magic.

name: Infernal Realm
description: Realm of demons and diabolists, bindable only by those given to diabolism.

name: Divine Realm
description: Realm of God and Divine spirits; Divine auras interfere with magic.

name: Realms of Power: The Divine
description: Supplement referenced for Divine spirits and the Dream Interpreter Virtue.

name: Spirit Familiar
description: Minor Mystery Virtue allowing a magus to bond a ghost or incorporeal spirit as familiar.

name: Familiar
description: Magical animal or spirit bonded to a magus via three cords.

name: Ghost
description: Spirit of a dead person, bound by fetters, insubstantial, unable to learn; may be bound or taken as familiar.

name: Elemental spirit
description: Spirits corresponding to their elemental Form that may welcome being familiars.

name: Demon
description: Infernal spirit; dealing with demons is banned by the Code and taking one as familiar inflicts Infernal taint.

name: Angel
description: Divine spirits some magi claim to have bound; Aldebert prayed to named angels.

name: Faerie
description: Faerie spirits that magi with Faerie Magic can ally with as familiars.

name: Infernal taint
description: Taint afflicting a magus who takes a demon as spirit familiar.

name: Three Cords
description: The golden, silver and bronze cords of a familiar bond, renamed Hermes, Isis and Hekate Cords for spirit familiars.

name: Hermes Cord
description: Spirit familiar cord corresponding to the golden cord, also adding to Enigmatic Wisdom rolls.

name: Isis Cord
description: Spirit familiar cord corresponding to the silver cord, adding to Lab Totals and Casting Scores involving spirits.

name: Hekate Cord
description: Spirit familiar cord corresponding to the bronze cord, adding to Stamina rolls when the familiar spends Might.

name: Enigmatic Wisdom
description: Ability to whose rolls the Hermes Cord adds.

name: True Friend
description: Minor Virtue gained by magus and spirit familiar toward each other.

name: Second Sight
description: Ability to perceive invisible spirits and overhear a spirit familiar's silent speech.

name: Inscription on the Soul
description: Minor Mystery Virtue letting a magus enchant his own spirit or body as his talisman.

name: Verditius Mystery
description: Mystery of House Verditius whose special abilities do not apply to Inscription on the Soul.

name: House Verditius
description: Hermetic House whose Mystery is referenced in contrast to Inscription on the Soul.

name: Warping
description: Magical distortion; Warping Points are inflicted by body enchantments and broken attunements.

name: Twilight
description: Magical state risked through Warping; Final Twilight ends a magus's link to his spirit.

name: Blending with Substance
description: Enchantment letting a magus embed small items in his flesh for talisman attunement, at the cost of Warping.

name: Great Talisman
description: Minor Virtue similar to Blending with Substance; not needed with Inscription on the Soul.

name: Consummate Talisman
description: Major Virtue letting a talisman hold Muto Vim meta-magic effects and Names of Power.

name: Ordeal of Deleterious Circumstance
description: Ordeal required for Consummate Talisman.

name: Vulgar Alchemy
description: Mystery allowing discovery of new Shape and Material items for charged and lesser devices.

name: Shape and Material Bonus
description: Bonuses from items' shapes and materials, attuned in talismans and a model for Names of Power bonuses.

name: Living Ghost
description: Major Hermetic Mystery Virtue in which a magus is bound to a Haunt and ritually killed to become a free-willed immortal ghost.

name: Haunt
description: The area to which a Living Ghost's spirit is bound; if destroyed, the ghost is unbound.

name: Bind the Living Ghost
description: Cr(Pe/Re)Me(Co) Mystery Ritual defining a Living Ghost's Haunt, destroying the body and binding the spirit.

name: Transformation of the Living Ghost
description: General Mystery Ritual defining a Living Ghost's Might Score, limited by the magus's best Arts.

name: Graculus
description: Example magus who becomes a Living Ghost with a 1,000-pace Haunt and Might 50; later Graculus Defunctus.

name: The Living Ghost
description: Graculus' Rego Mentem 80 ritual providing him Might 50.

name: Calebais: The Broken Covenant
description: Supplement in which the Ghosts in Ars Magica material first appeared.

name: Ghostly Body
description: Living Ghost power letting it turn invisible, pass walls and ignore physical attacks.

name: Ghostly Magic
description: Living Ghost power spending Might to make spells affect the physical world.

name: Ghostly Vis
description: Living Ghost power expending Might Score as raw vis.

name: Possess the Living Host
description: ReCo 30 spell letting a ghost enter and control a living body.

name: Possess the Deceased Host
description: Similar spell letting a ghostly magus possess and animate a corpse.

name: Charm Against Putrefaction
description: CrCo 10 spell recommended alongside corpse possession.

name: Immortal Magi
description: Appendix topic on magi becoming immortal beings of magic.

name: Aldebert
description: Heretical 740s preacher in northern France who prayed to angels Uriel, Raguel, Tubuel and others.

name: Uriel
description: Angel named in Aldebert's heretical prayer.

name: Raguel
description: Angel named in Aldebert's heretical prayer.

name: Tubuel
description: Angel named in Aldebert's heretical prayer.

name: Michael
description: Angel named in Aldebert's heretical prayer.

name: Adinus
description: Angel named in Aldebert's heretical prayer.

name: Tubuas
description: Angel named in Aldebert's heretical prayer.

name: Sabaoc
description: Angel named in Aldebert's heretical prayer. Derived from Sabaoth.

name: Simiel
description: Angel named in Aldebert's heretical prayer. Identified with Samael, Satan.

name: Samael
description: Identified with Satan and with the angel Simiel.

name: Louis the Pious
description: Ninth-century ruler during whose reign high magic was in vogue.

name: Gerbert of Aurillac
description: Tenth-century scholar who studied in Spain, suspected magician, became Pope Sylvester II.

name: Dionysus Exiguus
description: Collector of Church canons banning names of non-scriptural angels.

name: Hadrian I
description: Pope (772-795) who revised Dionysus Exiguus' canons.

name: Key of Solomon
description: The greatest grimoire, key grimoire of the middle ages, attributed to Solomon.

name: Solomon
description: Biblical king to whom a book of demon-summoning incantations was attributed.

name: Gnosticism
description: Early Christian-era cults on names and the soul's ascent, from which Hermetic name magic derives.

name: Synthemata
description: Secret signs, symbols or passwords linking a magician to a spirit.

name: The City of God
description: St. Augustine's work distinguishing dulia from latria.

name: Dulia
description: Honor due to a man or power according to its dignity, such as veneration of a saint.

name: Latria
description: Honor and praise due only to God.

name: Name of Power
description: MuVi general spell granting a bonus like a Shape and Material bonus, level five times the bonus.

name: Names of Power
description: Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue letting a maga invoke names of great powers in her magic as meta-magic.

name: Hermetic Synthemata
description: Virtue letting magi work synthemata into magic to command spirits.

name: Synthemata Magic
description: Virtue working synthemata as a channel to command spirits.

name: Invoke
description: Hermetic theurgy spell type summoning a spirit, which can incorporate Names of Power.

name: Invocation Magic
description: Virtue letting a magus cast Names of Power as meta-magic boosting the Casting Score of another spell.

name: Demiurge
description: God's intermediary per theurgists, seen variously as good or as an evil spirit creating Divine and Infernal auras.

name: Jehovah
description: Name used by pagan polytheists for the god they consider merely the most powerful deity.

name: Apotheosis
description: The greatest secret of theurgy: transcending mortality to become a god.

name: Psychopompic tradition
description: Belief that the soul must pass spiritual guardians after death by knowing secret passwords.

name: Spell Spirits
description: Spirits of limited intelligence summoned by Invoke spells to cast a matching spell.

name: Mystery Cults
description: Secretive cults teaching Mysteries such as name magic and Inscription on the Soul.

name: Hermetic Arts
description: Techniques and Forms that must be opened to model Hermetic divination.

name: Intellego
